info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Prehnitc Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information regarding Prehnitc produce within the catalog. Users can submit new produce details, ensuring that product information remains current and comprehensive. This functionality is essential for stakeholders in agriculture and retail who require accurate product specifications and updates to enhance inventory management and sales strategies. Typically, this API serves developers integrating catalog functionalities into e-commerce platforms and agricultural databases.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for prehnitc produce. It accepts the necessary information in the request body to generate the details required for processing.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to create or update details of prehnitc produce. It should include all relevant attributes needed for the operation, ensuring that the data adheres to the expected schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and data returned.

CreateCatalogPrehnitcProduceDetailReques.title: Prehnitc Produce Details Request

prehnitc_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the Prehnitc produce.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting this produce.

quantity.description: The quantity of the produce being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the produce.

CreateCatalogPrehnitcProduceDetailReques.description: This schema represents the request body for creating a new Prehnitc produce detail entry.
